scenarios.title: Tripling modifies power and toughness instead of setting them, so a later base-value effect still shows the bonus

setup.notes: Tifa's Limit Break is a tiered spell: its total cost is {G} plus the chosen tier's cost.

decisions: A casts Tifa's Limit Break choosing the Final Heaven tier ({6}{G}), targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping eight Forests.
Both players pass; Tifa's Limit Break resolves.
A casts Humble targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Plains.

variants.label: triple_then_humble
variants.expected: After Final Heaven, Grizzly Bears is 6/6 (+4/+4). After Humble sets its base power and toughness to 0/1, Grizzly Bears is 4/5: the +4/+4 from the tripling is still applied on top of the new base.

variants.label: humble_then_triple
variants.delta: A casts and resolves Humble first, then Tifa's Limit Break with the Final Heaven tier.
variants.expected: After Humble, Grizzly Bears is 0/1. Final Heaven gives +0 power and +2 toughness (twice 0 and twice 1). Grizzly Bears is 0/3.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the tiers as a Charm with ModeCost.

scenarios.title: Tripling a creature's power and toughness adds twice each value as the spell resolves

setup.notes: Tifa's Limit Break is a tiered spell: its total cost is {G} plus the chosen tier's cost.

decisions: A casts Tifa's Limit Break choosing the Final Heaven tier ({6}{G}), targeting Hill Giant, tapping eight Forests.
Both players pass; Tifa's Limit Break resolves.

variants.label: plain
variants.expected: Hill Giant (3/3) gets +6/+6 and is 9/9 until end of turn.

variants.label: pump_in_response
variants.delta: With Tifa's Limit Break on the stack, A casts Giant Growth targeting Hill Giant, tapping the ninth Forest. Giant Growth resolves first.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is 6/6 when Tifa's Limit Break resolves, so it gets +12/+12. Hill Giant is 18/18 until end of turn.

variants.label: double_tier
variants.delta: A chooses the Meteor Strikes tier ({2}) instead of Final Heaven, tapping Forests for {G}{2}.
variants.expected: Hill Giant gets +3/+3 and is 6/6 until end of turn: doubled, not tripled.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the tiers as a Charm with ModeCost.

scenarios.title: Tripling a negative power gives a further negative modifier of twice its size

setup.notes: Wall of Wood with Dead Weight is -2/1.

decisions: A casts Tifa's Limit Break choosing the Final Heaven tier ({6}{G}), targeting Wall of Wood, tapping eight Forests.
Both players pass; Tifa's Limit Break resolves.

variants.label: negative_power
variants.expected: Power -2 triples to -4/-0 (twice the difference from 0) and toughness 1 triples to +0/+2. Wall of Wood (-2/1) is -6/3 until end of turn.

variants.label: zero_power
variants.delta: Dead Weight is not on the battlefield, so Wall of Wood is 0/3.
variants.expected: Wall of Wood gets +0/+6 and is 0/9 until end of turn: a power of 0 is not negative and triples to +0.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Triple may compute the modifier as twice the value without special handling of negatives; the expected values follow the rule text.
